https://jenkins.openbmc.org/job/ci-repository/137181/console : SUCCESS
Can you also look at the CI failures in these patches and fix the issues?

Hi, the failures are because the APIs in libpldm is not updated from ABI_TESTING to ABI_STABLE yet. I already sent a patch [here](https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/libpldm/+/82483?usp=submitted-together)
Can we maintain uniformity and make this 0x00 ?
Done
Are all thr types here defined in the DSP0242 spec?
They are defined as enum of the field `FileClassification` in DSP0248 v1.3.0 - Table 108 – File Descriptor PDR
Done
I don't think we should move DSP0242 related code to separate dir/files.
Should I create another folder for `file-transfer`, like how `fw-update` pieces are placed?
There's no other comment since then so marked resolved. Please re-open if necessary.
can we have a null check of the pointer `file` before we dereference it?
Done
can we avoid this here and have a utils function or so?
There's no other place in pldm using this regex's function, can we do that when it expands to more than one? Just my question.
Acknowledged
magic number?
I added a clearer and more detailed comment section above this, can you help review. Should I define a const expression for this number?
Acknowledged
why was this removed?
Because the header file is including itself but it happens to bypass error due to `#pragma once`
Acknowledged
Did we get +1s on the design to represent each file as a D-Bus object?

It hasn't received a +1 yet or any further review until now. So I think some code lines will help demonstrate the design better. I put all the replated patches (design doc, D-Bus interface, codes) into the same topic for better tracing https://gerrit.openbmc.org/q/topic:%22PLDM_File_Transfer%22
Update: the design doc just got one +1.
Done
I think these definitions should go into libpldm as they are stated in the spec.
ACK. Will create a patch to libpldm.
libpldm patch to support the enum: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/libpldm/+/84738. I will update this when the patch gets some first approvals.

There's already one `trimNameForDbus` function in common/utils.cpp being used in placed but it only replaces spaces with underscores while in this case, a file name can contain many more anti-dbus characters (e.g ".", "-", etc). In this latest version of this patch, I declare the regex as a static const at the beginning of the file.
wouldn't this be a better fit as a utility function ?

Although this looks like a util function but the file object it takes and its implementation is pretty specific to the File Descriptor PDR and the FileInfoStruct. Not to mention that it's only used in this file, so I think it's suitable to be defined here only. Should I define it a as global function in the file, instead of a member function?
Done
this should be a constant from libpldm as well right ?

I think you're viewing the old version of this patch. I now define this as a static const `virtualTopMostFileId` on the top. I don't think it suits to be in libpldm as the spec does not mention a file with this 0xFFFF ID to be a top most file, but only says that a file with a parent ID of 0xFFFF means it's not under any directory. I just define this virtual top most ID for the terminus name to be constructed at the root of the path. Please help see the latest version and you will see a comment section I explain about this.
can we have a check if the pdrData is empty and log a trace?
Done
do you want to log an error here before we return?
Done
do we need to include the basepath here to know which basePath there was an error?
Done
can we have a check file->name.empty() before regex, otherwise regex_replace will just return empty string which could result in bad objPath ?
Right now, std::regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9_/]+") is constructed every call (and every recursion). Better to make it static const?
Yes. I added a check here and a check to skip files with empty object paths before calling std::make_shared<FileDescriptor>.
Agree. I added an `objPathAntiPattern` static const.
const auto& child ?
`constructFilePathRecursive` needs to modify objPath field of child, so child needs to be non-const.
yes, let's define a constexpr constant with a semantic name
Done
redundant?
Done
Risk of underflow if length is 0 or 1. Should we validate before subtracting 1?
Added a check to skip adding file with a zero file name length or empty file name to the fileInfoMap.
redundant std::move?
This move is to avoid copying of the shared pointer but to directly transfer the ownership of the shared_ptr into fileInfoMap, so no ref count increasemen/decreasement needed.
Acknowledged
Can we remove the static_cast? I think lg2 does require that.
pdrHdr is a packed struct, so the lvalue reference in lg2 is not allowed to be bound to its element. Removing the cast will result in a compile error.
return?
Done
Because these todo will be removed in the next patch. So I think we don't need add here.
Done
Do we want to explicitly have a value here? The enum first member is usually 0.
I set it 0 for clarity and to make it clear to readers that OEM is intended to be 0.
Do we need `buildFileHierarchy()` when there is no filePDR?
Done
return when fileDescriptorPdrs is empty.
Done
Include the terminus name parent path as discussion on other patch set.
The topMostInfo contains terminusName as file name and it is placed on top of the file hierarchy as a virtual topmost file, so the path will always have <terminusName> in it.
Please remove the lg2::debug() or you can change lg2::info
Used lg2::info().
@chaul@amperecomputing.com - is there a plan for unit tests for these - especially API's that constructs dbus path's recursively e.t.c could be well tested with unit tests.
Yes there will be unit tests for parsing File Descriptor PDRs. I will start working on those when this gets enough acceptance.
